messages.text: There’s one leftover renamed partial install directory from the npm recovery attempt. I’m removing only that generated `node_modules.bad.*` directory inside this workspace.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$root=(Resolve-Path .).Path; Get-ChildItem node_modules.bad.* -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if($_.FullName.StartsWith($root)){ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }'
